LegoAbout.HeroDesc: From a humble carpenter's workshop in Billund to the world's most iconic creativity empire extending to screens everywhere.

1932.title: From Wooden Toys to Legend
1932.desc: Ole Kirk Kristiansen began a journey that would one day lead to the world's largest toy brand by producing wooden yo-yos and toys in a modest workshop in the town of Billund, Denmark.

1934.title: Leg Godt" (Play Well)
1934.desc: The company took its name "LEGO" from the Danish phrase "leg godt," meaning "play well." Little did anyone know it would one day become an empire.

1947.title: First Encounter with Plastic
1947.desc: LEGO purchased Denmark's first plastic injection molding machine. This risky and bold move was the first spark that would transform the company's fate from wood to modern technology.

1949.title: Automatic Binding Bricks
1949.desc: The first prototype of the legendary LEGO brick, "Automatic Binding Bricks," was launched.

1954.title: The Philosophy of the "Play System
1954.desc: Godtfred Kirk Christiansen believed that toys should not be disposable. He realized the idea of a "Systematic Play" where all sets worked together harmoniously, fostering infinite creativity.

1958.title: The Perfect Connection Code: Patent
1958.desc: The patent for the modern LEGO® brick, featuring studs on top and tubes on the bottom, was granted in Denmark at precisely 13:58. The perfect clutch power changed the world.

1968.title: The First LEGOLAND® Opens
1968.desc: The first LEGOLAND theme park that opened in Billund exceeded expectations. While 3,000 visitors were anticipated in its inaugural season, it astonishingly hosted 625,000 guests.

1978.title: The Birth of the Minifigure (History in the Making)
1978.desc: The first LEGO Minifigure, characterized by iconic facial expressions, moving arms, and legs, was launched, marking the reason for our platform's existence. The brick world now had its inhabitants!

1999.title: First Licensed Theme: Star Wars
1999.desc: LEGO ventured beyond its own themes by partnering with Lucasfilm to produce the first Star Wars™ sets. This move became a modern milestone for the company.

2010.title: The Collectible Minifigures (CMF) Craze
2010.desc: The first Collectible Minifigure (CMF) Series 1, consisting of bodies, legs, heads, and accessories sold in closed, surprise bags, hit the shelves.

2024.title: A Continuing Legacy
2024.desc: Today, trillions of bricks have been produced. The minifigure population has already surpassed the human population. And you are part of this magnificent world of collections...
